principle: A claim status does not improve merely because it is repeated; each status requires re-checkable evidence.

evidence.claim: The prior public homepage loaded and described requests as a pre-confirmation step.
evidence.limitation: A content fetch is not a full interactive browser test.

evidence.claim: The prior public health endpoint returned ok=true and storage=available.
evidence.limitation: Does not prove every read/write operation, private access, or data durability.

evidence.claim: Search API and discovery page returned 404 on the public alias at audit time.
evidence.limitation: These paths existed in a separate Vercel deployment tree but were not on the alias observed.

evidence.claim: The prior admin page shell loaded.
evidence.limitation: Admin authorization, listing, status update, and privacy behavior were not verified end-to-end.

evidence.claim: Stable observed deployment and latest listed deployment were different IDs.
evidence.limitation: Alias must be queried again immediately before production changes.

evidence.claim: Loofy147/La9ta was empty when source files were first requested; this work created the initial source tree.
evidence.source: GitHub Contents API response before first README commit
evidence.limitation: Repository contents evolve with later commits; refer to the current commit tree.

evidence.claim: The long deployment file response was truncated and must not be treated as complete source.
evidence.source: Vercel get_deployment_file_contents responses with visibly incomplete long code
evidence.limitation: Small files may have been complete, but byte-for-byte equivalence was not established.

evidence.claim: The repository contains a clean implementation of catalog, request intake, private Blob storage, authenticated admin routes, and bounded Teno search.
evidence.limitation: Needs CI result and Vercel Preview end-to-end verification before behavior is considered experimentally supported.

evidence.claim: Node tests cover item validation, subtotal semantics, source host validation, allowed status transitions, and selected privacy/cache contracts.
evidence.limitation: Must confirm workflow result; static tests are not a penetration test.

evidence.claim: The new repository is connected to the old Vercel project.
evidence.limitation: No such connection has been performed or verified.

evidence.claim: The new repository deployment uses the previous production Blob store.
evidence.limitation: No storage link or migration has been configured for the new project.
